meaning.en: The standard greeting for the Spring Festival (Chinese New Year).
meaning.zh: 春节的通用祝辞。

examples.zh: 给大家拜年，新春快乐！
examples.en: Happy New Year to everyone!

examples.zh: 商场挂着“新春快乐”的红色横幅。
examples.en: A red banner saying 'Happy Spring Festival' hung in the mall.

usage.en: A set greeting: used from New Year's Eve to the Lantern Festival; 新年快乐 is also fine on 1 January. Neutral to warm.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：从除夕到元宵节都用；公历元旦则更常说“新年快乐”。中性偏亲切。

natural: may there be a surplus every year

meaning.en: A New Year wish for abundance and savings every year, with a pun on 鱼 (fish) and 余 (surplus).
meaning.zh: 新年祝愿年年有富余，“余”与“鱼”谐音。

equivalents: may you always have more than enough

examples.zh: 年夜饭上少不了鱼，寓意年年有余。
examples.en: A fish is a must at the reunion dinner, standing for 'surplus every year'.

examples.zh: 窗上贴着一幅年年有余的年画。
examples.en: A New Year picture of 'surplus every year' was pasted on the window.

usage.en: A set greeting: a Spring Festival pun: 鱼 and 余 are homophones (yú), so a fish dish, left partly uneaten, and fish pictures bring wishes of abundance. Also written 年年有鱼. Cheerful and casual.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：春节谐音祝福：“鱼”与“余”同音，年夜饭的鱼要留一部分，年画也常画鱼，寓意富余。也写作“年年有鱼”。喜庆，口语。

meaning.en: A congratulation on the opening of a business.
meaning.zh: 祝贺商店、公司开业顺利的祝辞。

equivalents: a lucky start to the business

examples.zh: 花篮上写着“开业大吉”。
examples.en: The flower basket was labelled 'Congratulations on the opening'.

examples.zh: 他的新店今天开业大吉，客人络绎不绝。
examples.en: His new shop had a lucky opening today, with a steady stream of customers.

usage.en: A set greeting: on banners, flower baskets and cards at shop openings. Formal and festive; 开张大吉 is the more colloquial variant.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：见于开业的横幅、花篮和贺卡。正式喜庆；“开张大吉”更口语。

meaning.en: A congratulation on moving into a new house.
meaning.zh: 祝贺迁入新居的祝辞。

examples.zh: 恭贺李先生乔迁新居！
examples.en: Congratulations to Mr Li on moving into his new home!

examples.zh: 同事乔迁新居，我们送了一盆绿植。
examples.en: A colleague moved into a new home, and we gave a potted plant.

usage.en: A set greeting: 乔迁 comes from the Book of Songs image of a bird flying up to a taller tree, so it implies a move 'up'. Used on cards and invitations; formal.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：“乔迁”取《诗经》中鸟儿迁往高树的意象，含迁往更好处之意。用于贺卡和请柬，正式。

meaning.en: A wish for good luck on moving into a new house or office.
meaning.zh: 祝贺迁居或迁入新办公地点吉利顺利。

equivalents: good luck in your new home

examples.zh: 门口贴着红色的“乔迁大吉”。
examples.en: 'A most auspicious move' was pasted in red at the door.

examples.zh: 祝公司乔迁大吉，事业蒸蒸日上！
examples.en: Congratulations on the company's move, and may the business flourish!

usage.en: A set greeting: also used for businesses moving premises; the 大吉 ending makes it a short blessing for banners and messages. Formal.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：也用于公司搬迁；“大吉”收尾使它成为适合横幅和短信的祝福。正式。

meaning.en: A congratulation on the completion of a new house.
meaning.zh: 祝贺新房建成。

equivalents: congratulations on your new house being built

examples.zh: 恭贺新居落成，福星高照！
examples.en: Congratulations on the completion of your new home; may good fortune shine on it!

examples.zh: 乡亲们送来贺联，庆祝他家新居落成。
examples.en: The villagers brought couplets to celebrate the completion of his new house.

usage.en: A set greeting: especially for a house that has been built, not merely bought or rented; common in rural or traditional celebrations. Formal.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：尤指自己建成的房子，而不是买或租的；多见于乡村或传统庆贺。正式。

natural: to be united in heart for ever

meaning.en: A wedding wish that the couple remain united in heart for ever.
meaning.zh: 婚礼祝辞，愿新人永远同心。

examples.zh: 婚礼请柬上印着“永结同心”。
examples.en: The wedding invitation was printed with 'united in heart for ever'.

examples.zh: 祝新郎新娘永结同心，白头偕老！
examples.en: We wish the bride and groom lasting unity and growing old together!

usage.en: A set greeting: a wedding card and banner staple. 同心结 (the 'same-heart knot') is a traditional love knot. Formal; often followed by 白头偕老.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：婚礼贺卡和横幅的常见用语。“同心结”是传统的爱情结。正式，常接“白头偕老”。

natural: may you soon have a precious child

meaning.en: A traditional wedding wish that the couple soon have a child.
meaning.zh: 传统婚礼祝福，愿新人早日生子。

equivalents: may you soon be blessed with a baby

examples.zh: 新婚宴上大家笑着说：“早生贵子！”
examples.en: At the wedding feast everyone laughed and said, 'May you soon have a baby!'

examples.zh: 喜床上撒着红枣、花生，取“早生贵子”之意。
examples.en: Red dates and peanuts were scattered on the bed, for 'an early child'.

usage.en: A set greeting: the dates 枣, peanuts 花生, lotus seeds and longans put on the wedding bed echo the wish. Traditional and cheerful; some couples now find it presumptuous, so use it with care. Casual to neutral.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：喜床上放红枣、花生、桂圆、莲子，取早生贵子之意。传统喜庆；如今有的新人觉得催生不妥，宜谨慎。口语到中性。

natural: a perfect match made in heaven

meaning.en: A wedding wish describing a couple as naturally and perfectly matched.
meaning.zh: 形容一对夫妻是天生的好配偶。

examples.zh: 两位新人郎才女貌，真是佳偶天成。
examples.en: The couple are so well matched; truly a match made in heaven.

examples.zh: 祝你们佳偶天成，幸福一生。
examples.en: May you be a perfect match and happy for life.

usage.en: A set greeting: wedding banners, speeches and cards. Formal, literary; also used of couples in the news or fiction.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：婚礼横幅、致辞和贺卡。正式，偏书面，也用于新闻或小说中的情侣。

natural: husband and wife in perfect harmony

meaning.en: A wish that husband and wife live in harmony, like two instruments played together.
meaning.zh: 比喻夫妻感情和谐，像琴瑟合奏一样。

examples.zh: 祝新人琴瑟和鸣，举案齐眉。
examples.en: May the couple live in harmony and treat each other with respect.

examples.zh: 老两口几十年琴瑟和鸣，让人羡慕。
examples.en: The old couple have lived in harmony for decades, and everyone envies them.

usage.en: A set greeting: 琴 and 瑟 are two ancient zithers often played together; the image goes back to the Book of Songs (《诗经》). Literary wedding wish; for a gentler 'everyday' wish use 百年好合.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：琴和瑟是两种常合奏的古乐器，此喻可上溯《诗经》。偏书面的婚礼祝辞；平常的祝福可用“百年好合”。

meaning.en: A wedding wish for a lifelong harmonious marriage.
meaning.zh: 祝愿夫妻一生和谐美满。

examples.zh: 红联写着“百年琴瑟”四字。
examples.en: The red couplet bore the four characters 'a hundred years of harmony'.

examples.zh: 祝二位百年琴瑟，永结同心。
examples.en: We wish you a hundred years of harmony and hearts united.

usage.en: A set greeting: a shorter, more literary cousin of 琴瑟和鸣, mainly on wedding scrolls and cards. Rarely spoken.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：比“琴瑟和鸣”更简短、更书面，主要用于婚礼字幅和贺卡，很少口说。

natural: to grow old together for a hundred years

meaning.en: A wedding wish that the couple live together until old age.
meaning.zh: 祝愿夫妻相伴到老。

examples.zh: 祝新人百年偕老，幸福美满。
examples.en: We wish the newlyweds a lifetime together in happiness.

examples.zh: 婚礼上，证婚人祝他们百年偕老。
examples.en: At the wedding the witness wished them a lifetime together.

usage.en: A set greeting: a common variant of 白头偕老, with 百年 as 'a lifetime'. Formal; for weddings and anniversaries.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：与“白头偕老”相近的常用说法，“百年”指一生。正式，用于婚礼和纪念日。

meaning.en: A phrase announcing or congratulating a happy marriage.
meaning.zh: 宣布或祝贺美好姻缘。

examples.zh: 两位新人今天喜结良缘。
examples.en: The couple are happily joined in marriage today.

examples.zh: 请柬上写着：谨订于十月一日喜结良缘。
examples.en: The invitation read: we are to be happily married on 1 October.

usage.en: A set greeting: on invitations and in wedding speeches; often 喜结良缘 is used for the union itself, 祝 for the wish. Formal.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：用于请柬和婚礼致辞，既说婚事本身，也可作祝愿。正式。

natural: happily united as husband and wife

meaning.en: A phrase for a happy marriage, from two trees whose branches grow together.
meaning.zh: 喜庆地指结为夫妻，用两棵树枝干相连作比。

examples.zh: 他们在去年春天喜结连理。
examples.en: They happily married last spring.

examples.zh: 祝你们喜结连理，相伴一生。
examples.en: We wish you a happy marriage and a life together.

usage.en: A set greeting: 连理 are branches of two trees that have grown together, a classical image of married love (as in Bai Juyi's 在地愿为连理枝). Formal and literary.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：“连理”指两棵树枝干相连，是古典诗文中夫妻恩爱的意象（如白居易“在地愿为连理枝”）。正式，偏书面。

meaning.en: Used of lovers who overcome obstacles and finally marry.
meaning.zh: 指有情人历经阻碍，最后结为夫妻。

examples.zh: 经过多年等待，两人终成眷属。
examples.en: After years of waiting, the two finally married.

examples.zh: 愿天下有情人终成眷属。
examples.en: May lovers everywhere end up together.

usage.en: A set greeting: both a blessing and a narrative phrase ('they finally got together'); the full saying is 有情人终成眷属. Neutral, positive.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：既是祝愿也是叙述语（“终于在一起了”），完整说法为“有情人终成眷属”。中性偏褒。

meaning.en: A wish that someone's studies go well and succeed.
meaning.zh: 祝愿学业顺利、取得成就。

examples.zh: 祝你学业有成，早日学成归来！
examples.en: May you succeed in your studies and return soon!

examples.zh: 他学业有成，被名校录取。
examples.en: He did well academically and was admitted to a top university.

usage.en: A set greeting: a farewell wish to students going abroad or graduates, and a plain description ('having succeeded in studies'). Neutral, formal in cards.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：送给出国留学生和毕业生的祝愿，也可平述“学有所成”。中性，贺卡中偏正式。

natural: a future as bright as brocade

meaning.en: A wish that someone's future will be splendid.
meaning.zh: 祝愿对方的前途像锦缎一样美好。

examples.zh: 祝毕业生前程似锦！
examples.en: We wish the graduates a bright future!

examples.zh: 他年轻有为，前程似锦。
examples.en: He is young and capable, with a bright future ahead.

usage.en: A set greeting: graduation, farewell and job-change blessing; also describes someone with good prospects. Neutral, very common in cards and speeches.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：毕业、送别和跳槽时的祝福；也可形容前途光明的人。中性，贺卡和致辞中很常见。

synonyms: 天戴其苍，地履其黄；纵有千古，横有八荒；前途似海，来日方长

meaning.en: A wish for people to live long and for harvests to be rich.
meaning.zh: 祝愿人民长寿、年成丰收。

examples.zh: 春联横批是“人寿年丰”。
examples.en: The horizontal scroll of the New Year couplet reads 'long life and plenty'.

examples.zh: 但愿风调雨顺，人寿年丰。
examples.en: May the weather be kind, and people live long with good harvests.

usage.en: A set greeting: from the rural wish for good harvests and healthy people; used on couplets and in communal blessings. Formal, slightly old-fashioned.
usage.zh: 固定祝辞：源于农村对丰收和平安长寿的期盼，用于春联和集体祝福。正式，略显古雅。

meaning.en: To take people's needs and wellbeing as the starting point and the basis of policy or management.
meaning.zh: 把人的需要和福祉作为政策、管理的出发点和根本。

examples.zh: 这座城市的规划始终坚持以人为本。
examples.en: The city's planning has always put people first.

examples.zh: 企业管理要以人为本，关心员工的成长。
examples.en: Management should be people-centred and care about employees' growth.

usage.en: a modern official slogan in government, business and education texts (promoted in China since the early 2000s as 'people-oriented' development). Formal; its roots are in the old idea of 民本 ('the people as the root of the state'). Used as predicate or in 坚持以人为本.
usage.zh: 现代官方口号，常见于政府、企业和教育文件（2000年代初起大力倡导的“以人为本”）。正式；思想根源是古代的“民本”。作谓语或用于“坚持以人为本”。

meaning.en: China's policy since 1978 of economic reform at home and opening to the outside world.
meaning.zh: 指中国自1978年起实行的对内改革、对外开放的政策。

examples.zh: 改革开放以来，中国经济发展很快。
examples.en: Since reform and opening-up, China's economy has grown fast.

examples.zh: 我家在改革开放初期搬到了深圳。
examples.en: My family moved to Shenzhen in the early years of reform and opening-up.

usage.en: a proper noun-like term for the policy launched in December 1978 under Deng Xiaoping. Always formal; in everyday talk it also marks the period (改革开放前后 'before and after the reforms'). Treat the political meaning neutrally.
usage.zh: 类似专有名词，指1978年12月邓小平主导启动的政策。总是正式；日常也用来指一个时期（“改革开放前后”）。

meaning.en: To live side by side peacefully, especially of states or groups with different systems or views.
meaning.zh: 和平地相处，尤指不同制度、不同观点的国家或群体之间。

examples.zh: 不同文化的人应该学会和平共处。
examples.en: People of different cultures should learn to live together in peace.

examples.zh: 两国提出和平共处五项原则。
examples.en: The two countries put forward the Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence.

usage.en: a diplomatic term (和平共处五项原则 from 1954) but also used in everyday life for neighbours, species or groups getting along. Formal, positive.
usage.zh: 外交用语（1954年提出和平共处五项原则），也用于邻居、物种或群体和睦相处。正式，褒义。

antonyms: 不是东风压倒西风，就是西风压倒东风

meaning.en: A society in which people, groups and institutions live in harmony and fairness.
meaning.zh: 人与人、群体与制度之间公平和谐的社会。

examples.zh: 政府提出要建设和谐社会。
examples.en: The government has called for building a harmonious society.

examples.zh: 公平正义是和谐社会的基石。
examples.en: Fairness and justice are the cornerstones of a harmonious society.

usage.en: an official term, most associated with the 'building a harmonious socialist society' goal set out in 2004-2006; 和谐 itself goes back to Confucian ideals of 和. Formal, used in news and policy texts. Kept neutral in tone here; critics sometimes use it ironically.
usage.zh: 官方用语，与2004至2006年提出的构建社会主义和谐社会目标联系最紧；“和谐”本身可追溯到儒家的“和”。正式，见于新闻和政策文件。也有人带讽刺地使用。
